messages:
alex: Heads-up: we need to lock the cross-func sync for next Wed to review RFCs and roadmap tradeoffs. Who can own agenda? Proposed 45m at 9am PT / 5pm BST. Ping owners.

maya: 9am PT works for me. I can take the design-review section (10 min).

santiago: I prefer 11am PT tho — back-to-back with infra planning at 9. If we keep 9, I might be late. :grimacing:

jess (PM): We should aim for max overlap with EU folks. 9am PT = 5pm BST ok. But 45m might be tight. Propose 60m and clear owners. Also need decision-log note-taker.

oliver: 60m fine. I can do note-taking / decision log.

alex: Thanks. Agenda draft below — feel free to tweak. @maya you're design, @santiago can you do triage/risk call? If you can't, we need a backup.

alex: ```
1) Quick updates (5m) - alex
2) RFC: caching fallback policy (15m) - santiago (or backup)
3) Design review: batching/caching proposal (15m) - maya
4) Roadmap tradeoffs & capacity (15m) - jess
5) Decisions & action items (10m) - oliver
```

maya: Looks good. For the RFC, can we share the one-pager before Monday? I'll pre-read.

santiago: I can own RFC but prefer to shift slot order (put design before RFC) — design discussion impacts RFC scope. OK?

jess (PM): Putting design first SGTM. Also pls add 'rollout plan for caching' to decisions.

alex: Agree. Updated agenda — design then RFC. Can we confirm by EOD Friday? Also adding a calendar invite — @everyone please RSVP.

agenda-bot: Calendar invite created for Wed 2026-04-22 09:00 PT (60m). Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcd1234

oliver: :thumbsup: added to calendar. Will prep decision log template.

jess (PM): Small ask: can we record meeting? We might need it for regulatory audit.

alex: Yes I'll enable recording and add link to the decision log after meeting.

santiago: Confirmed — will post the RFC doc in #docs before Monday. @maya if you need data I'll share latency histograms.

maya: Please do, latency histos would help. Thanks.
